industries.narrative: Storage and AI-infrastructure names (WDC, STX, SNDK, DELL, ANET) driving a +2.5% cap-weighted move with 72% breadth, though volume is light.
Perfect 100% breadth across all 12 gold miners, led by NEM and AU, but very low relative volume suggests drift higher rather than institutional accumulation.

sector_breadth_notes.note: Tech strength is narrow — Computer Hardware (storage/AI infra) is the lone qualifier. Other tech industries did not clear the gate, suggesting a hardware-specific bid.
XLB move is entirely precious-metals-driven. Gold posts 100% breadth while Steel collapses (14% advancing, 2.58 score). Not a broad cyclical recovery.
XLY qualifies at sector level but internals are ugly: Lodging, Apparel Mfg, Apparel Retail, Resorts, Footwear all sub-3.0. Move is mega-cap masking weak breadth.
Real estate sector strength masks broad industry weakness — Industrial, Office, and Residential REITs all scoring sub-3.0 with <18% advancing.

key_divergences: Sharp split inside XLB: Gold 100% advancing vs Steel 14% — classic risk-off precious metals bid, not cyclical demand. XLRE and XLY headline strength contradicted by laggard internals, suggesting mega-cap-led, narrow tape.
leadership_theme: Defensive gold + storage/AI hardware leading; cyclicals, REITs, and discretionary internals broken
